summary: The NIFTY index on two clients: an LTP holder, then a Quote holder (the desktop moves the touchline subscription from LTP to Quote with an unsubscribe and a subscribe); the snapshot and a partial serve both, each at its mode, with the change fields an index carries; the Quote holder leaving moves it back.

notes: Noren's index touchline carries no volume, average price, last quantity or totals.
The desktop derives the percent change from LTP and close and replaces Noren's own pc (audit FB-07); the web forwards pc.
Upstream the desktop answers an LTP-to-Quote change with u then t for the same touchline; the web sends nothing (both modes ride one touchline subscription).

deviations.reason: Noren's index touchline carries no average price; the web's Zebu adapter sends 0 for it, the desktop leaves it out, as web openalgo#2376 asks (a field the feed does not carry is left out, never sent as 0).

Noren's index touchline carries no last quantity; the web's Zebu adapter sends 0 for it, the desktop leaves it out, as web openalgo#2376 asks (a field the feed does not carry is left out, never sent as 0).
The web's Zebu adapter forwards Noren's trade time ltt (HH:MM:SS, null when the frame has none) as last_trade_time; the desktop's carrier has no place for it.

The desktop sends Noren's feed time ft, in ms, as ltt: a packet time, not the trade time. Noren's trade time is its ltt (HH:MM:SS, IST), which the web forwards raw as last_trade_time; the web's Zebu adapter sends no ltt key in any mode, LTP included. Closed in phase B by the per-broker dialect switch (lane wire), set to what this adapter does (lead rule 2026-11-09).

The web's Zebu adapter puts its subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full) for every broker. Closed in phase B by the per-broker dialect switch (lane wire), set to what this adapter does (lead rule 2026-11-09).
The desktop derives the percent change from LTP and close and replaces Noren's own pc with it whenever it can derive one; the web forwards pc as percent_change.

The desktop sends an index's change since the previous close as price_change and price_change_percent (and percent_change beside it); the web's Zebu adapter sends Noren's pc as percent_change and no price_change keys. Closed in phase B by the per-broker dialect switch (lane wire), set to what this adapter does (lead rule 2026-11-09).

The desktop sends an index's change since the previous close as price_change and price_change_percent (and percent_change beside it); the web's Zebu adapter sends Noren's pc as percent_change and no price_change keys. Closed in phase B by the per-broker dialect switch (lane wire), set to what this adapter does (lead rule 2026-11-09).
The web forwards Noren's feed time ft (epoch seconds) as zebu_timestamp; the desktop drops it.
